name: pilotcode
description: Local-first, offline-capable Copilot clone for VS Code powered by Qwen / Ollama / any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Inline completions, chat, agentic mode, and full MCP support.

chatParticipants.name: pilotcode
chatParticipants.description: Local-first AI coding assistant powered by Qwen / Ollama.

commands.name: fix
commands.description: Find and fix bugs in the selected / active code

commands.name: test
commands.description: Generate unit tests for the selected / active code

commands.name: refactor
commands.description: Refactor the selected / active code for clarity

pilotcode.endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Examples: Ollama -> http://localhost:11434/v1 ; LM Studio -> http://localhost:1234/v1 ; vLLM -> http://localhost:8000/v1

pilotcode.apiKey.description: API key (only required for remote/cloud endpoints; leave empty for local Ollama/LM Studio).

pilotcode.chatModel.description: Model name to use for chat & agentic tasks. Examples: qwen2.5-coder:7b, qwen3-coder:14b, llama3.1:8b.

pilotcode.completionModel.description: Smaller model used for fast inline (ghost-text) completions. A *base* model (not instruct) is recommended.

pilotcode.maxContextTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens of context (prompt + completion) the model can handle.

pilotcode.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for chat responses. Lower = more deterministic.

pilotcode.enableInlineCompletions.description: Enable inline ghost-text completions (press Tab to accept, Alt+] / Alt+[ to cycle suggestions).

pilotcode.enableTelemetry.description: PilotCode is offline-first and ships with telemetry OFF. Toggle on only if you want to help improve the extension.

pilotcode.logLevel.description: Verbosity for the PilotCode output channel.

enumDescriptions: Auto-detect: use fill-in-the-middle for *-base / *-coder models, instruct prompting otherwise.
Force fill-in-the-middle (FIM). Requires a model trained with FIM tokens, e.g. qwen2.5-coder:*-base.
Force instruct prompting via /chat/completions. Works with any chat model (qwen3.5, qwen3.6, llama3.1, ...).
pilotcode.completionStrategy.description: How inline completions are prompted. 'auto' is recommended.

pilotcode.completionDebounceMs.description: Idle time (ms) to wait after the last keystroke before requesting a completion. Lower = snappier but more requests.

pilotcode.completionMaxTokens.description: Maximum tokens generated per inline completion.

pilotcode.completionTemperature.description: Sampling temperature for inline completions. Low values keep completions deterministic.

pilotcode.completionPrefixLines.description: How many lines *before* the cursor to include as context.

pilotcode.completionSuffixLines.description: How many lines *after* the cursor to include as context.

pilotcode.completionMaxContextChars.description: Hard cap on prefix+suffix characters sent to the model. Text closest to the cursor is kept.

pilotcode.completionMultiline.description: Allow multi-line completions. When off, completions are truncated at the first newline.

pilotcode.completionCount.description: Number of alternative suggestions to request (cycle with Alt+] / Alt+[). >1 issues parallel requests and is slower on local models.

pilotcode.prewarmOnActivation.description: Fire a tiny throw-away completion shortly after activation so Ollama loads the completion model into RAM. Eliminates the 10-30s cold-load latency on your first real ghost-text request.
